sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 9953 of 2024
Petitioner :- Abhishek And Another

Respondent :- State Of U.P And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Akhilesh Kumar Pandey,Liladhar

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Anjani Kumar Mishra,J.
Hon'ble Vinod Diwakar,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The instant writ petition seeks quashing of the Fir dated 24.04.2024 giving rise to Case Crime
No.0143 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304B, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition
Act, P.S. Etmaddaula, District Agra.

Abhishek And Another vs State Of U.P And 3 Others on 10 June, 2024
Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13683209/
1

3.

Upon hearing learned counsel for the parties and upon a perusal of the record, we find that the submissions made on behalf of the petitioners are his defence, which cannot be looked into while dealing with a writ petition seeking quashing of a first information report.
4. Moreover, the allegations made in the First Information Report clearly disclose commission of cognizable offences and the allegations are serious in nature.

Therefore, prayer of the petitioners to quash the First Information Report is completely misconceived and is rejected.
5.
The writ petition is therefore dismissed, without prejudice to the right of the petitioners to apply for bail/anticipatory bail.
